title: Towards GPROF V08: A Machine-Learning Framework for Simulating Passive Microwave Observations of Precipitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19966v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatially resolved precipitation retrievals based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) can improve precipitation estimates from passive microwave (PMW) observations and will be used to implement the next operational PMW retrieval algorithm for the Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) mission. However, the conventional radiative transfer simulations used to extend the retrieval algorithm to the various sensors of the GPM constellation do not provide the spatial coverage required to train CNN-based retrievals.   To address this, we introduce a machine-learning-based simulation framework that enables the training of the CNN-based GPROF-NN 3D retrieval algorithm for the full GPM constellation. At the core of this framework is Satformer, a new neural-network architecture that can translate PMW observations between any pair of GPM sensors. translated_title: 迈向GPROF V08：一种用于模拟降水被动微波观测的机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的空间分辨降水反演方法能够改善基于被动微波（PMW）观测的降水估计，并将被用于实现全球降水测量（GPM）任务的下一代业务化PMW反演算法。然而，用于将反演算法扩展至GPM星座各传感器的传统辐射传输模拟，无法提供训练基于CNN的反演算法所需的空间覆盖范围。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个基于机器学习的模拟框架，使得能够在整个GPM星座上训练基于CNN的GPROF-NN 3D反演算法。该框架的核心是Satformer——一种新型神经网络架构，可以在任意一对GPM传感器之间转换PMW观测数据。所生成的合成观测数据相比传统辐射传输模拟表现出更低的误差
tldr: 本文提出了一个以新型神经网络架构Satformer为核心的机器学习模拟框架，能够在GPM星座任意传感器之间转换被动微波观测，从而为基于CNN的GPROF-NN 3D降水反演算法提供所需的训练数据，且误差低于传统辐射传输模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a machine-learning simulation framework centered on Satformer, a novel neural network architecture that translates passive microwave observations between any pair of GPM sensors, enabling the training of the CNN-based GPROF-NN 3D retrieval algorithm across the full GPM constellation with lower errors than conventional radiative transfer simulations.
